objective: Create an evidence-backed broker/exchange execution inventory and machine-readable scorecards for the canonical Crypto + Forex tradable universe without selecting or activating a production venue.
scope: Inventory candidate crypto execution venues for BTC/ETH spot and perpetual products
Inventory candidate Forex brokers/APIs for the canonical core FX pairs
Document official order lifecycle, client-order identifiers, fills/cancels/rejects and reconciliation capabilities
Document sandbox/demo/paper/testnet availability and parity limitations
Document public API rate/pacing limits and symbol/instrument metadata mechanisms
Document API credential/permission models and withdrawal-separation evidence where publicly documented
Document margin/leverage and account-control considerations at a research level
Document status/maintenance/operational recovery mechanisms where publicly available
Carry jurisdiction/account eligibility questions to P01-D without inferring Owner jurisdiction
out_of_scope: Deposit, fund, withdraw or transfer assets
Place/cancel/modify any real or simulated order
Enable Demo, Shadow, Live or Auto Trading
tests: Execution venue scorecards JSON parses successfully
Each venue has a unique venue_id
Every material capability claim has official_source_refs or is explicitly unknown
No venue is marked production selected or live approved
Sandbox/paper/testnet parity limitations are recorded where known
Withdrawal permission is not assumed disabled unless official evidence supports separation
No credentials or order actions are introduced
security_tests: Project policy requires trading credentials without withdrawal authority where venue permits
Broad-scope token models are flagged for security review
evidence: Official Coinbase Advanced Trade API documentation
Official Interactive Brokers API/IBKR Campus documentation
rollback: Revert P01-C research artifacts and state/catalog reconciliation. No accounts, credentials, funds or runtime integrations are created.
definition_of_done: Crypto and Forex execution candidate classes are documented
Unknown jurisdiction and account eligibility questions are deferred to P01-D
No final execution venue is selected
Task Catalog and Current State are reconciled
